The child's extended arm and gaze clearly designate the entire faraway group: THOSE plural things over there. Preserve a visible span of empty ground and water between speaker and target, and make the three far bushes distinct and readable. One coherent outdoor scene, no arrows, map pins, or text.
Style: hand-painted gouache with subtle colored-pencil texture on warm off-white paper, soft daylight, natural muted green, blue and coral, simple appealing educational illustration. Composition: one clear tightly related scene centered in the middle 70 percent, generous warm-white empty space; fully visible main subjects, large clear silhouettes. Constraints: no letters, written words, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks, borders, card UI, or unrelated decorative objects. Render one square image only.
